description: This file defines the interface and data structures for interacting with an object database in a version control system, including functions for reading, writing, and managing objects and sources.

classes.name: odb_source
classes.description: Represents a source of objects in the object database, such as the main directory or alternates, including metadata like path, local status, and private state.

classes.name: object_database
classes.description: Encapsulates access to objects within a repository, managing sources, transactions, and object caching.

classes.name: object_info
classes.description: Structure used to hold information about a specific object, including type, size, and location details.

classes.name: odb_write_stream
classes.description: Interface for streaming object data into the database for writing.

methods.name: compute_alternate_path
methods.description: Computes the exact path of an alternate object store, returning NULL on error.

methods.name: odb_new
methods.description: Creates a new object database instance for a given repository.

methods.name: odb_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an object database.

methods.name: odb_close
methods.description: Closes the object database, releasing resources but allowing reuse.

methods.name: odb_reprepare
methods.description: Reloads object sources and alternates to make new objects accessible.

methods.name: odb_transaction_begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction for batch object writes.

methods.name: odb_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, making written objects visible.

methods.name: odb_find_source
methods.description: Finds a source by its directory path, returning NULL if not found.

methods.name: odb_find_source_or_die
methods.description: Finds a source by path or terminates if not found.

methods.name: odb_set_temporary_primary_source
methods.description: Replaces the primary source temporarily, returning the old source.

methods.name: odb_restore_primary_source
methods.description: Restores a previously replaced primary source.

methods.name: odb_add_submodule_source_by_path
methods.description: Adds a submodule's object store path to the database.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate
methods.description: Iterates over all alternate sources, executing a callback.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate_ref
methods.description: Iterates over references of all alternate sources.

methods.name: odb_mkstemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the primary alternate directory.

methods.name: odb_prepare_alternates
methods.description: Prepares alternate sources based on the 'alternates' info file.

methods.name: odb_has_alternates
methods.description: Checks if the database has any alternate sources.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_file
methods.description: Adds a directory to the on-disk alternates list.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_memory
methods.description: Adds a directory to the in-memory list of alternates.

methods.name: odb_read_object
methods.description: Reads an object by ID, returning data and type info.

methods.name: odb_read_object_info_extended
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about an object, including location and delta info.

methods.name: odb_write_object_ext
methods.description: Writes an object to the database with extended options.

methods.name: odb_write_object
methods.description: Writes an object to the database.

methods.name: odb_write_object_stream
methods.description: Streams object data into the database for writing.

methods.name: enable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Enables locking for thread-safe object reading.

methods.name: disable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Disables locking for object reading.
